name: inset-notch
why: A 100 x 60 rectangle with a 20 wide, 15 deep notch in its top edge, inset by 5 and extruded 5. The notch is wider than twice the inset and survives, 30 wide and 15 deep: 90*50 - 30*15 = 4050 mm2, 20250 mm3 exactly, ten planar faces. Two re-entrant corners, (65,40) and (35,40), each 5*sqrt(2) from the outline's corner, both read as valleys by the guard.
